entities.name: Streptococcus gallolyticus
observations: Formerly Streptococcus bovis biotype I; gram-positive, catalase-negative, gamma-hemolytic cocci in chains that fail to grow in 6.5% NaCl.

entities.name: Colon cancer
observations: Streptococcus gallolyticus endocarditis is strongly associated with concurrent colorectal neoplasia; reported meta-analysis odds ratio 14.54, 95% CI 5.66–37.35.
Invasive Streptococcus gallolyticus infection warrants evaluation for occult colorectal neoplasia.

entities.name: Infective endocarditis
observations: The clinical presentation includes fever, aortic-valve vegetation, and Streptococcus gallolyticus bacteremia.
